NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: RS-R Remote uses Bluetooth to find, connect to, and control your GoPro camera.
NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: RS-R Remote uses Bluetooth to communicate with your GoPro camera.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RS-R Remote uses your location to discover nearby GoPro cameras and connect to their Wi-Fi.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: RS-R Remote connects to your GoPro's Wi-Fi network to stream live preview video.
